statistical_unit: paired independent fact with both contexts; known/unknown stratified fixed-size bootstrap and whole-fact method swaps
confidence_event: correct original factual answer on ext/param/align or spontaneous refusal on abstain; source/new validation frozen temperatures
ece_bins: 10 equal-width bins, p=1 included in last bin
oracle_cache_diagnostics: post-unblinding diagnostic only; uses known state for route, no new generation; confidence uses fixed source All temperature proxy and is not an oracle-calibrated posterior
inferential_limitations: Known/unknown strata and policy selection treated as frozen; CI conditional on locked labeling and development fit
Independent second dataset is natural NQ questions/passages with synthetic answer substitution, not organically occurring natural conflict
No independent cross-model pooling performed; each six-test family retains separate model contrasts
Source timing on locked PopQA inputs is not NQ fixed-budget automatic timing
